sha_binding.verified_source_note: Head a9c96afd introduced the containment workflow and a 9-test contract suite. Independent Claude Opus 5 exact-head review returned APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES with one release-blocking P0: the remote script is delivered on ssh stdin via `bash -s`, and `docker compose exec` keeps stdin attached by default (-T disables only the TTY), so the first printenv call drained the remainder of the heredoc — the remote shell reached EOF and exited 0 having created no backup, made no edit and performed no restart, while the step reported success. Commit 6c45d45b closes that P0 two independent ways (per-command </dev/null redirection plus a completion sentinel the runner asserts), adds an EXIT restore trap covering the mutate/validate window, surfaces the deploy.yml durability reversion, guards appends against a missing trailing newline, and raises the contract suite from 9 presence checks to 18 assertions. A final PM-directed amendment adds the canonical production-deploy concurrency mutex shared with deploy.yml and its parity test, taking the suite to 19 assertions verified non-tautological by 16 injected mutations.

pnpm_verify.note: pnpm verify:parallel green on 6c45d45b (lint + type-check in parallel, then build + full test suite); pnpm test:db run separately against live Supabase, also green

test.note: scripts/ci/ops-p0-containment-workflow.test.ts: 19/19 pass (raised from 9). The file was NOT wired into any package script as delivered, so pnpm test/pnpm verify would never have run it — the same silently-unwired-test defect found and closed under UTV2-1592. It is now listed in package.json test:ops, which raises that suite from 1242 to 1260 tests, all passing. New coverage: stdin redirection of every remote docker/curl call, completion sentinel presence and runner assertion, restore-on-failure trap ordering, trailing-newline guard, workflow-context interpolation, network egress targets, bare docker verbs, non-API services including grading-cron, database/credential/distribution surfaces, and bash -n syntax validation of every run block. Final amendment adds a production-deploy concurrency mutex parity test that reads the group out of deploy.yml rather than hardcoding it, so a rename on either side fails the suite.

mutation_verification.note: Each mutation was applied to the workflow, the suite re-run, and the workflow restored. Cases: remove </dev/null from a compose exec (the P0); remove </dev/null from the compose up restart; remove the completion sentinel; docker compose down; bare docker stop of another service; add grading-cron to the restart; docker pull; interpolate the confirm input into a run block; psql delete; webhook curl -X POST; remove the failure-restore trap; mutate before the backup; shell syntax error. Concurrency mutations added: remove the concurrency block; rename the containment mutex group; set cancel-in-progress true; rename deploy.yml's mutex group (drift).

receipts.note: Live Supabase. This lane ships CI/ops tooling with no DB schema or query changes; test:db establishes the live-DB suite remains undisturbed. The suite writes its own fixture rows, which are test artifacts and must be excluded from any production pick or settlement count.

environment_protection.note: Verified live via the GitHub environments API, not merely asserted by the workflow YAML. Human approval is required for every containment run. The two permissive settings are surfaced for PM awareness.

blast_radius.note: Merging this PR performs no production mutation. Execution requires PM dispatch and human approval of the production environment gate. The workflow can only set two named flags to false and recreate the api service at its existing image.

concurrency_mutex.note: Containment and deploy both rewrite .env.production on the same host. The shared workflow-level mutex prevents a deploy from interleaving with containment and restoring SYNDICATE_MACHINE_ENABLED from the repository secret between containment's write and its restart. cancel-in-progress is false so a containment run is never cancelled between backup and restart.
